description: This file defines a React component for visualizing workflow Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) using React Flow and DeckGL. It manages layout, data fetching, node/edge styling, search, and interaction features for workflow visualization.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGResponse
classes.description: Interface representing the response structure for a workflow DAG, including nodes, timeline, and metadata.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGControls
classes.description: Interface for controls to manipulate the DAG view, such as fitting to view and focusing on nodes.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGViewerProps
classes.description: Props for the main WorkflowDAGViewer component, including data, callbacks, and configuration options.

methods.name: isLightweightDAGResponse
methods.description: Type guard to check if the response is a lightweight DAG response.

methods.name: mapLightweightNode
methods.description: Maps a lightweight node to the full WorkflowDAGNode structure.

methods.name: adaptLightweightResponse
methods.description: Converts a lightweight response into a full WorkflowDAGResponse.

methods.name: WorkflowDAGViewerInner
methods.description: Main React component implementing the workflow DAG visualization with layout, search, and interaction logic.

methods.name: WorkflowDAGSkeleton
methods.description: Loading skeleton component shown during data fetch.
